title: KrishokTech: A Bengali Agricultural Advisory System with Explicit Authorization Controls
abstract: arXiv:2610.32817v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For agricultural advisory, generating an answer is only part of the problem: the system must also control unsafe requests, work with limited connectivity, and accommodate changing guidance. KRISHOKTECH is a Bengali agricultural advisory system built around an explicit authorization boundary around generation. Before retrieval, normalization and rule-based admission checks refer policy-covered high-risk requests and ask for a crop when treatment intent is underspecified. The system then binds retrieval to a single crop and asks for confirmation when the text and image indicate different crops. After generation, a narrow verifier removes dosage claims not supported by retrieved BARI/BRRI evidence. Agricultural guidance is kept in an external evidence index that can be updated without retraining the generator, while browser-side vision and local retrieval reduce connectivity requirements. translated_title: KrishokTech：一个具有显式授权控制的孟加拉语农业咨询系统
translated_abstract: 对于农业咨询而言，生成答案只是问题的一部分：系统还必须控制不安全的请求、在有限网络连接条件下工作，并适应不断变化的指导建议。KRISHOKTECH 是一个围绕生成过程构建了显式授权边界的孟加拉语农业咨询系统。在检索之前，规范化处理和基于规则的准入检查会将政策涵盖的高风险请求转交处理，并在治疗意图不明确时要求用户提供作物信息。随后，系统将检索绑定到单一作物，并在文本与图像显示的作物不一致时要求确认。生成之后，一个范围严格的验证器会删除检索到的 BARI/BRRI 证据所不支持的剂量声明。农业指导内容保存在一个外部证据索引中，该索引无需重新训练生成器即可更新，同时浏览器端视觉处理和本地检索降低了对网络连接的要求。界面将这些决策以 ASK 等形式直观呈现（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: KRISHOKTECH 是一个孟加拉语农业咨询系统，其核心创新在于围绕生成过程构建显式授权边界——通过高风险请求拦截、作物确认机制和剂量声明验证等控制措施，并结合可独立更新的外部证据索引与本地检索，在低网络连接环境下安全可靠地提供农业建议。
en_tdlr: KRISHOKTECH is a Bengali agricultural advisory system whose key contribution is an explicit authorization boundary around generation—blocking policy-covered high-risk requests, binding retrieval to a single crop, and verifying dosage claims against BARI/BRRI evidence—while using an externally updatable evidence index and local retrieval to operate under limited connectivity.
